collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IX (161-180, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child lays out empty shells on the sand as a hotel for hermit crabs who need a bigger room.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has noticed that some hermit crabs on the beach are living in shells that are much too small for them. This seems very unfair. So (subject.he/she) has collected every empty shell (subject.he/she) can find and laid them out in a row on the sand, from small to large. It's a hotel, (subject.he/she) explains to (friend). For crabs who need a bigger room.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They sit very still and watch. For a long time nothing happens. Then a crab in a shell that's far too small wanders over, inspects three shells, climbs out of its old one and dashes into a bigger one, all in the blink of an eye. (subject) grabs (friend)'s arm so hard it hurts. "IT WORKED!"

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) leaves the shells out overnight. In the morning (subject.he/she) runs down to check. Some of the shells have moved. Some have gone. There's a very small old shell left where a big one used to be. (subject) can't be sure what happened, but (subject.he/she) decides the hotel had a very good night.
